project-based learning, supported by a LMS, is an effective learning approach.

the project-based creative product design course with LMS is effective for the development of the students' creativity and that the LMS can improve learning outcomes.

the design and implementation of a creative product design learning method that integrates project-based learning and learning management techniques.
the use of a LMS in a face-toface course.
the development of a new learning approach, the evaluation of this learning method and the analysis of the factors influencing the acceptance of the LMS.

this study provides evidence that a learning environment based on active learning, and LMS can have a positive impact in the learning of creative product design.
the active learning approach, based on the project-based learning method and the use of the LTI platform is a successful strategy for teaching creative product design.
this active learning approach has been found to be a successful strategy to promote creative design learning.

this active learning approach can be successfully implemented in a face-to face course.
a project-based approach is a promising strategy for creative design courses.
a learning approach based on project-based learning and LMS can be a good alternative in the design learning process.

the use of an active learning method in combination with a LMS is a promising strategy to improve the learning outcomes in the field of product design.
